text.tspan: Land use of foods per 1000 kilocalories
Land use is measured in meters squared (m²) for one year to produce 1000 kilocalories of a given food product.

tspan.tspan: Joseph Poore and Thomas Nemecek (2018). Additional calculations by Our World in Data.
The median year of the studies involved in this research was 2010.
